import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 6.31

by O. V. Mel'nikov

b) Let $G$ be a finitely generated residually finite group, $d(G)$ the minimal number of its
generators, and $\delta(G)$ the minimal number of topological generators of the profinite
completion of $G$. It is known that there exist groups $G$ for which $d(G) > \delta(G)$
(G. A. Noskov, *Math. Notes*, **33**, no. 4 (1983), 249–254). Is the function $d$ bounded on
the set of groups $G$ with the fixed value of $\delta(G) \geq 2$?

The profinite completion $\widehat{G}$ is realised here as the closure of the image of $G$ in
the product $\prod_N G/N$ of all its finite quotients (each carrying the discrete topology),
where $N$ ranges over the normal subgroups of finite index of $G$. The minimal number of
generators $d(G)$ is Mathlib's `Group.rank G`.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«6.31»

variable (G : Type*) [Group G]

/-- The normal subgroups of finite index of a group `G`. -/
abbrev FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup := {N : Subgroup G // N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex}

variable {G}

scoped instance (N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G) : N.1.Normal := N.2.1

scoped instance (N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G) : N.1.FiniteIndex := N.2.2

/-- Each finite quotient `G ⧸ N` carries the discrete topology. -/
scoped instance (N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G) : TopologicalSpace (G ⧸ N.1) := ⊥

scoped instance (N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G) : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ N.1) :=
  discreteTopology_bot _

variable (G)

/-- The natural map from `G` to the product `∏ N, G ⧸ N` of all its finite quotients. -/
def toFiniteQuotients : G →* ∀ N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G, G ⧸ N.1 :=
  Pi.monoidHom fun N => QuotientGroup.mk' N.1

/-- The profinite completion $\widehat{G}$ of `G`: the closure of the image of `G` in the
product `∏ N, G ⧸ N` of its finite quotients, where each `G ⧸ N` is discrete and the product
carries the product topology. It is a closed subgroup of a profinite group, hence a profinite
group. -/
def profiniteCompletion : Subgroup (∀ N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G, G ⧸ N.1) :=
  (toFiniteQuotients G).range.topologicalClosure

/-- The natural map from `G` to its profinite completion $\widehat{G}$. -/
def toProfiniteCompletion : G →* profiniteCompletion G :=
  (toFiniteQuotients G).codRestrict _ fun g => Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ ⟨g, rfl⟩

/-- The image of `G` is dense in its profinite completion $\widehat{G}$. -/
@[category API, AMS 20 22]
theorem denseRange_toProfiniteCompletion : DenseRange (toProfiniteCompletion G) := by
  rw [DenseRange, dense_iff_closure_eq, Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
  intro x
  rw [closure_subtype]
  have : Subtype.val '' Set.range (toProfiniteCompletion G) = Set.range (toFiniteQuotients G) := by
    ext y
    simp [toProfiniteCompletion]
  rw [this]
  exact x.2

/-- $\delta(G)$: the minimal number of topological generators of the profinite completion
$\widehat{G}$ of `G`, i.e. the least cardinality of a finite subset $S \subseteq \widehat{G}$
such that the subgroup generated by $S$ is dense in $\widehat{G}$. It is `⊤` if no such
finite set exists (this cannot happen when `G` is finitely generated, see
`profiniteRank_le_rank`). -/
noncomputable def profiniteRank : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ (S : Finset (profiniteCompletion G))
    (_ : (Subgroup.closure (S : Set (profiniteCompletion G))).topologicalClosure = ⊤),
    (S.card : ℕ∞)

/-- For a finitely generated group `G` one has $\delta(G) \leq d(G)$: the image of a
generating set of `G` topologically generates $\widehat{G}$. -/
@[category API, AMS 20 22]
theorem profiniteRank_le_rank [Group.FG G] : profiniteRank G ≤ Group.rank G := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hS'⟩ := Group.rank_spec G
  have key : (Subgroup.closure ((S.image (toProfiniteCompletion G) : Finset _) :
      Set (profiniteCompletion G))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hS', ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map,
      SetLike.ext'_iff, Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe, Subgroup.coe_top, ← dense_iff_closure_eq]
    exact denseRange_toProfiniteCompletion G
  refine (iInf₂_le (S.image (toProfiniteCompletion G)) key).trans ?_
  rw [← hS]
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le

/-- A group `G` is residually finite if every non-identity element of `G` maps to a
non-identity element in some finite quotient of `G`, i.e. lies outside some normal subgroup of
finite index. -/
def IsResiduallyFinite : Prop :=
  ∀ g : G, g ≠ 1 → ∃ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex ∧ g ∉ N

/-- Every finite group is residually finite. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem isResiduallyFinite_of_finite [Finite G] : IsResiduallyFinite G :=
  fun g hg => ⟨⊥, inferInstance, inferInstance, by simpa using hg⟩

/--
Let $G$ be a finitely generated residually finite group, $d(G)$ the minimal number of its
generators, and $\delta(G)$ the minimal number of topological generators of the profinite
completion of $G$. Is the function $d$ bounded on the set of groups $G$ with the fixed value
of $\delta(G) \geq 2$?

That is: for every $n \geq 2$, is there a constant $C$ such that $d(G) \leq C$ for every
finitely generated residually finite group $G$ with $\delta(G) = n$?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«6.31».parts.b : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Group.FG G],
      IsResiduallyFinite G → profiniteRank G = n → Group.rank G ≤ C := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«6.31»

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 6.31

by O. V. Mel'nikov

b) Let $G$ be a finitely generated residually finite group, $d(G)$ the minimal number
of its generators, and $\delta(G)$ the minimal number of topological generators of the
profinite completion of $G$. It is known that there exist groups $G$ for which
$d(G) > \delta(G)$ (G. A. Noskov, *Math. Notes*, **33**, no. 4 (1983), 249–254).
Is the function $d$ bounded on the set of groups $G$ with the fixed value of
$\delta(G) \geq 2$?

Here the profinite completion $\widehat{G}$ is realised as the closure of the image of
$G$ in the product $\prod_N G/N$ over all finite-index normal subgroups $N$ of $G$, each
finite quotient $G/N$ carrying the discrete topology. A finite set topologically
generates $\widehat{G}$ if the subgroup it generates is dense in $\widehat{G}$.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«6.31»

variable (G : Type*) [Group G]

/-- A normal subgroup of finite index in `G`, packaged so that `G ⧸ i.N` is a finite group. -/
structure FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup where
  /-- The underlying subgroup. -/
  N : Subgroup G
  [normal : N.Normal]
  [finiteIndex : N.FiniteIndex]

attribute [instance] FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup.normal FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup.finiteIndex

/-- Each finite quotient `G ⧸ N` carries the discrete topology. -/
scoped instance (i : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G) : TopologicalSpace (G ⧸ i.N) := ⊥

scoped instance (i : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G) : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ i.N) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The natural homomorphism from `G` to the product of all of its finite quotients
`G ⧸ N`, `N` ranging over the normal subgroups of finite index. -/
def toProfiniteCompletion : G →* ∀ i : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G, G ⧸ i.N :=
  Pi.monoidHom fun i => QuotientGroup.mk' i.N

/-- The profinite completion $\widehat{G}$ of `G`: the closure of the image of `G` in the
product $\prod_N G/N$ of all of its finite quotients, where each `G ⧸ N` is discrete and the
product carries the product topology. -/
def profiniteCompletion : Subgroup (∀ i : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G, G ⧸ i.N) :=
  (toProfiniteCompletion G).range.topologicalClosure

/-- The image of `G` lies in its profinite completion. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem range_toProfiniteCompletion_le :
    (toProfiniteCompletion G).range ≤ profiniteCompletion G :=
  Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _

/-- The minimal number of topological generators of a topological group `Γ`: the least
cardinality of a finite subset generating a dense subgroup of `Γ`. -/
noncomputable def topologicalRank (Γ : Type*) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] : ℕ :=
  sInf {n | ∃ S : Finset Γ, S.card = n ∧ Dense (Subgroup.closure (S : Set Γ) : Set Γ)}

/-- $\delta(G)$: the minimal number of topological generators of the profinite completion
$\widehat{G}$ of `G`. -/
noncomputable def profiniteRank : ℕ :=
  topologicalRank (profiniteCompletion G)

/-- A group `G` is residually finite if every non-identity element of `G` lies outside
some normal subgroup of finite index, i.e. survives in some finite quotient of `G`. -/
def IsResiduallyFinite : Prop :=
  ∀ g : G, g ≠ 1 → ∃ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex ∧ g ∉ N

/-- Finite groups are residually finite. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem IsResiduallyFinite.of_finite [Finite G] : IsResiduallyFinite G := fun g hg =>
  ⟨⊥, inferInstance, inferInstance, by simpa using hg⟩

/--
Let $G$ be a finitely generated residually finite group, $d(G)$ the minimal number of its
generators, and $\delta(G)$ the minimal number of topological generators of the profinite
completion of $G$. Is the function $d$ bounded on the set of groups $G$ with the fixed value
of $\delta(G) \geq 2$?

That is: for every fixed $n \geq 2$, is there a constant $C$ such that every finitely
generated residually finite group $G$ with $\delta(G) = n$ satisfies $d(G) \leq C$?
Here $d(G)$ is `Group.rank G` and $\delta(G)$ is `profiniteRank G`.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«6.31».parts.b : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Group.FG G],
      IsResiduallyFinite G → profiniteRank G = n → Group.rank G ≤ C := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«6.31»

/-- The functor from the poset of normal subgroups of finite index of $G$ to the category
of finite groups sending $N$ to the finite quotient $G / N$, and an inclusion $N \leq M$ to
the natural projection $G / N \to G / M$. -/

  obj N := FiniteGrp.of (G ⧸ N.1)
  map f := FiniteGrp.ofHom (QuotientGroup.map _ _ (.id _) (leOfHom f))
  map_id _ := ConcreteCategory.ext <| QuotientGroup.map_id _

number of generators $d(G / N)$ over all normal subgroups $N$ of finite index in $G$.

  ⨆ N : {N : Subgroup G // N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex},

    Group.rank (G ⧸ N.1)

    ⟨⟨⊤, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩⟩
  refine ciSup_le fun N => ?_
  haveI := N.2.1
  exact Group.rank_le_of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' N.1) (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N.1)

/-- A group is residually finite if each nonidentity element remains
nonidentity under some homomorphism to a finite group. -/
def IsResiduallyFinite (G : Type) [Group G] : Prop :=

    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Group Q) (_ : Finite Q) (f : G →* Q), f g ≠ 1

the minimal number of topological generators of the profinite completion of

    Function.Surjective f ∧ Group.rank Q = n}
